journey.title: Think First! 💭
journey.studentText: A half (1/2) means one out of two equal parts. If you cut a sandwich into 2 equal pieces, each piece is 1/2.
journey.owlText: Take a moment to think about introduction to halves using rectangular cut-outs. What do you already know? There's no wrong answer!
